_readme: Cards/abilities that modify an attack. 'phase': ranged | melee | any (a card is skipped when it does not match the selected weapon). Effects (attacker): hit_mod, bonus_dice_per_model, bonus_dice_flat, dmg_mod, surge_bonus, set_surge_die, grant_surge_die + grant_surge_plus + grant_surge_tags, reroll_hits, precision, critical, anti_evade, pierce_x+pierce_tag. Effects (defender): armour_mod, evade_mod, grant_evade (target number), reroll_armour, tough, dodge, damage_reduction (per die), total_reduction (off total damage), attack_pool_reduction, shield_bonus, hp_bonus, ignore_surge. +1 mod = easier. Text transcribed from the official card sheets; some wording was garbled in the source (see 'note'). Unit-specific passives, upgrades and abilities now live on each unit in units.json ('options'). Each card has a 'faction' (Terran | Zerg | Protoss | Generic); the app only offers the selected faction's cards plus Generic ones. 'scope': "first" (default) = the card only affects the attacker's main weapon (the first gun); "all" = it affects every weapon (Sidearms too) and, on the defender side, Impact rolls. Total damage reduction, HP bonus and Shield bonus always apply to the whole attack. Optional 'when': {"own_size": N} makes a card apply only to a unit of exactly that Size (the attacker for attacker cards, the defender for defender cards). 'affects': "opponent" marks a debuff played by one side that changes the OTHER side's numbers: an attacker card then holds defender effects (e.g. armour_mod) and a defender card holds attacker effects (e.g. hit_mod).
